|---|---|---|---|
| ὀφρυόεσσα (Ἴλιος ὀφρυόεσσα, 22.411; ὀφρύς "brow", sense of the epithet for a city on its height not certain) | "brow-bearing" | "beetling" (+ note: usual explanation, sense not certain) | "high", "lofty", "steep" (each adds a picture the root does not give), "frowning" |
| κωκυτός (22.409, 22.447) | "outcry" | "outcry" | "shrieking", "wailing" (kept for οἰμωγή / οἰμώζω), "weeping" (κλαίω); κωκύω is "cry out" (the table's κώκυσεν, 18.37) |
| ὄνειαρ (22.433, 22.486) | "a help" | "a help" | "a blessing", "a benefit", "a profit", "food" (the other sense of the word, not meant here) |
| δύσμορος (22.481, δύσμορος αἰνόμορον) | "ill-starred" | "ill-starred" | "ill-fated" (kept for ἄμμορος, δυσάμμορος and κάμμορος), "unlucky", "wretched" (reserved for δύστηνος); αἰνόμορος keeps "dread-fated" / "grimly fated" (the table's αἰνόμοροι, 9.53) |
| δυσάμμορος (22.428, 22.485) | "ill-fated" | "ill-fated" | follows the table's δυσάμμορος (19.315) and ἄμμορον (6.408), unchanged |
| ὀδύρομαι (τῶν πάντων οὐ τόσσον ὀδύρομαι ἀχνύμενός περ, 22.424; a repeated line of the Odyssey) | "grieve" | "grieve" | "lament" (the Iliad's own rendering of ὀδύρομαι, 18.32): a departure, with the reason: the line is shipped in the Odyssey (odyssey-014) with "grieve", and a repeated line takes the English the packet shows |
| ὥς ὄφελεν θανέειν ἐν χερσὶν ἐμῇσι (22.426) | "if only he had died in my hands" | "if only he had died in my arms" | "would that he had died by my hand", "at my hands" (loses the picture of care); ὡς ὄφελεν keeps "if only" (the table's ὡς ὤφελες, 3.428) |

| ἐκτοθι πυλάων … μίμνε (22.439) | "was staying outside the gates" | "was staying outside the gates" | "was waiting", "lingered" |

| τι τοι (particle, αἰεί τοι τούτῳ γε, 22.488; ἀτάρ τοι, 22.510) | "surely" / "indeed" | left to the sense | "to you" (the dative σοι), "I tell you"; the note says τοι is the particle |
